$comment: Everything Swift shows: the watch app, its complication, the widgets (currently disabled), App Intents in Siri and Shortcuts, the notification the payment automation posts, the receipt reader. Compiled into apps/mobile/native/Localizable.xcstrings and typed accessors (L10n.*) in KPStrings.swift. Runtime text follows the language chosen in the app; App Intent and widget-gallery metadata (keys used as literals in Swift, marked in their notes) follow the phone's language. No select, no tags, at most one plural, and a plural message takes only its count.

today.note: Day heading on the watch's History page.

yesterday.note: Day heading on the watch's History page.

transfer.note: Title of a transfer between accounts on the watch's History page.

uncategorized.note: A transaction with no category, on the watch's History page.

noDatabase.message: No database on the iPhone yet

left.note: Under a budget on the watch and in the widgets; amount is formatted money, e.g. "420 PLN".

namedLeft.note: Lock Screen inline widget, one short line; name is the budget, amount compact ("1.2k").

fallback.note: Lock Screen widget when there is no budget to name.

perDay.note: Travel mode: what may be spent per day; amount is formatted money.

day.note: Travel mode, a trip with no end date: today is its day-th day.

dayOf.note: Travel mode: today is day `day` of a `days`-day trip.

intents.noAccounts: No accounts yet. Open Kopiyka on your iPhone first.

noCategory.note: The choice that saves without a category (Siri, Shortcuts).

noMoreTags.note: Siri asks for tags one by one; this choice ends the list.

received.note: Notification title after the automation logged income, when no payer name was read.

logged.note: Notification title after the automation logged a payment, when no shop name was read.

guess.note: In the notification body, after the category: the category was guessed. Lowercase, one word if possible.

pending.note: In the notification body: the entry waits in the Pending queue. Lowercase.

receipt.noImage: The photo could not be read.
receipt.noText: No text found. Hold the phone flat over the receipt with good light.

untitled.note: The shop's name when none could be read off the receipt; saved as the payee.

items.note: In the note a scanned receipt writes: "Żabka · 2 items: …".

total.note: In the note a scanned receipt writes; lowercase, it follows a ·.

paid.note: In the note a scanned receipt writes, when more was handed over than the total.

noRate.note: The receipt note when its currency could not be converted; currency is a code like EUR.

writes.$comment: Why the iPhone app could not take a write from Siri, a Shortcut or the watch. Shown after "Could not save: …".

downloading.message: {name} is still downloading from iCloud. Try again in a moment.
